verdict.rationale: PagerDuty ships AI and ML features (PagerDuty Advance, AI agents, ML-based Intelligent Alert Grouping), so a data-training privacy posture is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence documents an opt-out, a no-training commitment, or any control over whether customer data trains AI models. The security page covers government authorization, which is a different topic and earns no credit here.
